name: app/command-palette
title: CommandPalette
summary: "Go to anything": every navigation item, grouped, in a Popover API dialog opened by QuickSearch or ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Progressive enhancement: links and a GET form without script; live filtering and arrow keys with it.

props.name: groups
props.description: The same navigation data SideNav renders.

props.name: action
props.description: GET target for the search box when scripts do not run (the server answers `?q=`, e.g. with `searchNav`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog and the search box.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint in the empty search box.

behaviour: A popover with role="dialog"; Escape and a click outside close it (light dismiss).
Lists every item of `groups`, flattened, under its group's name ("Go to" for an unlabelled group), each a plain link; nested items show their trail ("Content › News").
With `action` the search box is a role="search" GET form, so search works without script.

With script: ⌘K / Ctrl+K toggles it, typing filters (diacritics folded) and announces "N matches" in a polite live region, Enter opens the first match, ↑/↓ move between results, and opening clears and focuses the box.

roles: status (polite live region for the match count)
keyboard: ↑ / ↓ move between results; ↑ from the first returns to the box (script).
Enter opens the first match (script) or submits the GET form.
focus: Opening moves focus to the search box.
Every result shows the `--ring` focus ring and a muted fill.
aria: The search box has a visually hidden <label>.
The match count is announced by aria-live="polite".
Group names are aria-hidden text; each <section> carries the name as aria-label.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: QuickSearch opens it, Escape closes it, every result is a link, and with `action` the box submits to the server.
noJs.with: ⌘K / Ctrl+K, live filtering with an announced count, Enter for the first match, arrow keys.

responsive: min(40rem, 100vw − 2rem) wide at 12vh from the top; the results scroll within min(60vh, 28rem).
Item descriptions and the key legend show from sm.
contract:
contract
  slot is "command-palette"
  role is "dialog"
  label is "Search"
  a "News" min_height 36
  when default shows a "Home"
  when form shows a "Events"
end

checks.say: Every nav item is a link.
